name: Griesser’s WeiLong V11 3x3 (Special Edition UV)
description: Griesser's WeiLong V11 3x3 (Special Edition UV) comes with MoYu's 20-Magnet Ball-Core installed alongside their spring dual adjustment system. This mechanism, accompanied stronger edge-corner and lighter piece-core magnetization, produces a more tactile, controllable feel that is sure to be a favorite!
